title: Simplex transport in the explicit cone-weight unstraightening
statement: Use simplicial sets, quasicategories, Kan complexes, internal functor simplicial sets and weak homotopy equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], in universes containing all displayed constructions. Use the coherent realization/nerve adjunction and $\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}=N_{\mathrm{hc}}\mathbf{Kan}_{\mathcal V}$ of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces], and the cone-weight unstraightening $U_K$ and its natural fibre comparisons of [lem-coef-simplicial-right-fibration-presentation]. Let $K$ be a small quasicategory, $A=\mathfrak C[K]^{\mathrm{op}}$, and $F:A\to\mathbf{Kan}_{\mathcal V}$ an enriched functor. Let $m_F:K^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}$ be its transpose under $\mathfrak C[K^{\mathrm{op}}]\cong A$. Under the natural equivalences $(U_KF)_k\simeq F(k)$, transport obtained by lifting in the right fibration $U_KF\to K$ agrees coherently with the action of $F$. For an edge $a:k\to l$ it is identified with $F(a):F(l)\to F(k)$. More precisely, a simplex of $U_KF$ over $\sigma:\Delta^r\to K$, represented by an enriched map $T_\sigma\to F$, restricts at the vertices to the fibre values; its subset-poset generators give the homotopies identifying a source value with the action on a target value, and union of subsets gives their iterated composition coherences. These comparisons commute with all faces, degeneracies, enriched maps $F\to G$, and additional simplicial parameters. A homotopy equivalence $E\to U_KF$ over $K$ identifies these same comparisons with the simplex lifts in $E$, using the induced fibre equivalences.
